lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots are organized in a semi-regular 2D grid of rows and columns posterior to the gill slits, with the largest and most distinct centroids located in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clear vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a distinct rectilinear matrix of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by sharp vertical gradients of high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a distribution of approximately 10-15 high-luminance blobs of varying sizes, dispersed across the visible lateral surface of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The head and snout regions exhibit a significantly higher density of smaller, more compact high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more spaced patterning found on the main body.
